candidate: Eastern collared lizard (Crotaphytus collaris collaris), Peck Ranch experimental restoration/reintroduction metapopulation

scientific_anchor.published_design: translocation/reintroduction beginning in 1984 on restored Ozark glades followed by long-term capture/recapture and glade surveys through 2014
scientific_anchor.source_process_claim: known managed introductions are external additions and must be prospectively represented by year/glade; natural expansion among the mapped glade universe is the target process. Any additional unmanaged external source not representable before response access stops the candidate.
scientific_anchor.historical_anchor: 1980 extensive Peck Ranch survey reported no collared-lizard populations; initial translocations occurred 1984-1989; prescribed woodland burning began 1994 and initiated the colonizing phase; stable metapopulation phase was established by about 2000.
